entities.summary: Frederick Charles Delahaye, sometimes spelled Delahay or Delahey, was a Canadian ice hockey player who competed in the 1928 Winter Olympics. In 1928 he was a member of the University of Toronto Grads, the team which won the Olympic gold medal for Canada.
